title: Flow manifest (flows/<flow>.json)
description: An ordered list of steps (contract §6). scripts/sdlc_runner/manifest.py adds the rules a schema cannot state: the first step is a run-once strategy step with one visit, step ids and gate ids are unique, each check carries exactly its own parameters (contract §7), a step with an approval check names that gate, references use the package-path syntax with {work_id} as the only placeholder, applies_when names this flow's forms and work types and a known probe value, an implement file map covers every work type, a loop step names a known loop whose modes include loop_mode, a mechanism-bearing step (contract §9 key as its id) names its own key and no other, a check's work_types are this flow's, and every required package input is written by an earlier step, by start (request.md) or by an import. Uses only the keywords scripts/sdlc_runner/schema.py supports.

entry_skill.description: The skill whose entry starts this flow when no flow is active.

loop_mode.description: The spec/plan loop mode of the draft step; null when no step runs a loop.

imports.description: Package files that start copies in from the user's project before the first step (contract §5.5 start options): path is the package path, option the start option that names the source file, status the frontmatter status the source must carry (the plan flow imports an approved spec); required false lets start leave the file out (default true: start refuses a missing source).

file.description: Plugin-relative step file; for implement, a map {work_type: file}.

inputs.description: Package-relative paths ({work_id} expands; #body fingerprints the body after the frontmatter; a trailing ? marks an optional file) or a named set @source, @tests, @diff, @start. A changed input makes a done step stale.

outputs.description: Package-relative paths the step writes, shown on the card; a trailing ? marks an optional file.

items.description: One check (contract §7). The parameters each check takes are enforced by manifest.CHECK_PARAMS; work_types is allowed on every check.

work_types.description: Any check: it applies only when the package's work type is listed (absent: always). A check that does not apply passes.

gate.description: Gate id of a gate step (its approval check names the same id).

run_once.description: Default false: a done step is never reopened by staleness.

applies_when.description: All keys must hold; decided once from start-time facts (not_option: the option was not given; imported: whether start imported any file). A probe error means the step applies.

role.description: The agent file (agents/<role>.md) whose role the step's card hands to a fresh reader.

role_reads.description: Package paths that role reads; only with role.

mechanism_key.description: The strategy entry this step's card prints (contract §9).

loop.description: A loop id under flows/loops/ (the draft step).
